by_expense_category.description: the same total broken down by the GL classification the planning-line accounts map to

currency.description: the currency of every amount on this record (`total_budget`), an ISO 4217 alpha-3 code as the source states it. A record with no currency has no usable amount.

financial_period.description: the accounting period the budget figure is the live value for

legal_entity_id.description: the BC company whose job planning lines the budget was read from

planning_line_count.description: number of salary planning lines folded into the total

project_id.description: The project the budget belongs to; the fact's subject anchor, read by Margin Watch.

total_budget.description: the budgeted amount for the project, summed over all planning lines
